versions.content: If development error detection for the module Eep is enabled: the functions Eep_Read() , Eep_Write() , Eep_Compare() and Eep_Erase() shall check that DataBufferPtr is not NULL. If DataBufferPtr is NULL, they shall raise development error EEP_E_PARAM_DATA , otherwise (if no development error detection is enabled) it shall return with E_NOT_OK .
